00001| // Deterministic fallback planner for repository change requests
00002| // (rust/src/agentic_coding/general_planner.rs, issue #654).
00003| //
00004| // A `GeneralChangePlan` is `{id, mode, goal, target, content, steps,
00005| // verification_command, terminal_state}`; `mode` is 'literal_file' |
00006| // 'command_output' | 'repository_work_item' (the Rust `GeneralPlanMode::slug`)
00007| // and `terminal_state` is 'executed' | 'planned_not_executed'. A step is
00008| // `{capability, action, expected_evidence, command}`.

00044| /** `GeneralPlanMode` slugs (`GeneralPlanMode::slug`). */

00047|   CommandOutput: 'command_output',
00048|   RepositoryWorkItem: 'repository_work_item',
00049| });

00057| const CAPABILITY_SLUGS = Object.freeze({

00059|   grep: 'Grep', glob: 'Glob', list_dir: 'ListDir', todo: 'Todo', subagent: 'Subagent',

00063| /**
00064|  * Mirrors `fn describes_code_to_author`: unquoted content that names a code
00065|  * construct (`a function multiply(a, b)`, seeded `coding_request_object`) is
00066|  * a description of code to write, not the file's bytes — writing it as the
00067|  * whole file destroyed `math.mjs` (PR #1188 dogfooding). Content a seeded
00068|  * content lead introduces (`containing`, `with exactly this content:`) is
00069|  * bytes whatever it mentions.
00070|  */
00071| function describesCodeToAuthor(request, content) {
00072|   if (content === '' || quotedSegments(request).some((segment) => segment.includes(content))) return false;
00073|   return (firstContentLeadEnd(request.toLowerCase()) === null && mentionsRole('coding_request_object', normalizePrompt(content)))
00074|     || asksToAuthorCode(proseAround(request, content));
00075| }
00076| 
00077| /**
00078|  * Mirrors `fn names_an_addition`: `Add <content> to <file>` -- the write verb
00079|  * is the seeded add action and the content comes before the file -- names an
00080|  * addition to that file, never its whole new content. Writing it as the file
00081|  * replaced `m.test.mjs` with the sentence "an assertion that add(2, 2) equals
00082|  * 4" (PR #1188 dogfooding). Content a seeded content lead introduces
00083|  * (`containing`, `with exactly this content:`) is still the file's bytes.
00084|  */
00085| function namesAnAddition(request, content, target) {
00086|   const toks = tokens(request);
00087|   const start = firstActionCueStart(toks);
00088|   const end = firstActionCueEnd(toks);
00089|   if (start === null || end === null || firstContentLeadEnd(request.toLowerCase()) !== null) return false;
00090|   const at = content === '' ? -1 : request.indexOf(content);
00091|   return at >= 0 && at < request.indexOf(target)
00092|     && mentionsRole('coding_member_add_action', normalizePrompt(request.slice(start, end)));
00093| }

00095| /**
00096|  * Mirrors `fn asks_to_author_code`: the request itself asks to write a code
00097|  * construct (`Write a Python function add(a, b) … in add.py and run it with 2
00098|  * and 3`), so whatever clause the write grammar picks as content (`2 and 3.`)
00099|  * is not the file's bytes.
00100|  */
00101| function asksToAuthorCode(prose) {
00102|   const normalized = normalizePrompt(prose);
00103|   return mentionsRole('coding_request_object', normalized) && mentionsRole('coding_request_verb', normalized);
00104| }

00106| /** Mirrors `fn prose_around`: the request without the content and its file paths. */
00107| function proseAround(request, content) {
00108|   return tokens(request.split(content).join(' '))
00109|     .filter((token) => !looksLikeFilePath(cleanPathToken(token.text)))
00110|     .map((token) => token.text).join(' ');

00113| /** Mirrors `GeneralChangePlan::links_notation`. */
00114| export function planLinksNotation(plan) {
00115|   let out = 'general_change_plan\n';
00116|   out += field('id', plan.id);
00117|   out += field('execution_mode', plan.mode);
00118|   out += field('terminal_state', plan.terminal_state);
00119|   out += field('goal', plan.goal);
00120|   out += field('target', plan.target);
00121|   plan.steps.forEach((step, index) => {
00122|     out += `  step ${index + 1}\n`;
00123|     out += fieldNested('capability', CAPABILITY_SLUGS[step.capability]);
00124|     out += fieldNested('action', step.action);
00125|     out += fieldNested('expected_evidence', step.expected_evidence);
00126|     if (step.command !== null) out += fieldNested('command', step.command);
00127|   });
00128|   if (plan.verification_command !== '') out += field('verification_command', plan.verification_command);
00129|   return out;
00130| }

00132| /** Mirrors `GeneralChangePlan::planned_not_executed_answer`. */
00133| export function plannedNotExecutedAnswer(plan) {
00134|   const language = detect(plan.goal);

00136|     .split(TARGET_PLACEHOLDER).join(plan.target)
00137|     .split('{plan_path}').join(PLAN_PATH)
00138|     .split('{plan}').join(fencedBlock(LINO_FENCE_LANGUAGE, planLinksNotation(plan)));

00141| /**
00142|  * Mirrors `fn objective_text`: the request after its first line-anchored
00143|  * objective marker, trimmed; the request itself when it carries none.
00144|  * @param {string} request
00145|  */
00146| export function objectiveText(request) {
00147|   const lead = firstRawPrefixLeadEnd(request, 'request_objective_lead');
00148|   if (!lead || !lineAnchored(request, lead[0])
00149|     || quotedSegmentSpans(request).some((segment) => lead[0] >= segment.start && lead[0] < segment.end)) return request;
00150|   return trim(request.slice(lead[1]));

00153| /** Mirrors `fn literal_payload`: a closed literal immediately introduced by a seeded content lead. */
00154| function literalPayload(request) {
00155|   const quoted = quotedSegmentSpans(request);
00156|   const literal = quoted.find((segment) => /^[\s.!?。！？।]*$/u.test(request.slice(segment.end)));
00157|   if (!literal) return null;
00158|   let prefix = request.slice(0, literal.start);
00159|   for (const segment of quoted.filter((segment) => segment.end <= literal.start).reverse()) {
00160|     prefix = prefix.slice(0, segment.start) + ' '.repeat(segment.end - segment.start) + prefix.slice(segment.end);
00161|   }
00162|   const normalized = normalizePrompt(prefix);
00163|   const overwrite = mentionsRole('file_overwrite_consent', normalized);
00164|   const lead = firstRawContentLeadEnd(prefix);
00165|   if (lead === null && !overwrite) return null;
00166|   // An embedded quoted field is not the entire marker-led payload.
00167|   if (lead !== null && !/^[\s:]*$/u.test(prefix.slice(lead[1]))
00168|     && !(overwrite && !prefix.slice(lead[1]).trimEnd().includes('\n'))) return null;
00169|   const words = tokens(prefix);
00170|   const actionStart = firstActionCueStart(words);
00171|   const actionEnd = firstActionCueEnd(words);
00172|   if (actionStart === null || actionEnd === null) return null;
00173|   return overwrite || mentionsRole('file_whole_write_action', normalizePrompt(prefix.slice(actionStart, actionEnd))) ? literal : null;
00174| }

00176| function lineAnchored(text, start) {
00177|   const before = Array.from(text.slice(0, start)).reverse();
00178|   for (const character of before) {
00179|     if (character === '\n') return true;
00180|     if (!isWhitespace(character)) return false;
00181|   }
00182|   return true;

00185| /**
00186|  * Mirrors `fn compose_general_change_plan`: a `GeneralChangePlan` or null.
00187|  * @param {string} fullRequest
00188|  */
00189| export function composeGeneralChangePlan(fullRequest) {
00190|   const request = objectiveText(fullRequest);
00191|   // An additive edit (append, prepend) never rewrites the whole file: the
00192|   // workspace-change arm owns it, and a request it cannot ground is declined.
00193|   const literal = literalPayload(request);
00194|   const instruction = literal === null ? request : request.slice(0, literal.start) + request.slice(literal.end);
00195|   const lowered = instruction.toLowerCase();
00196|   if (mentionsRole('file_edit_position_end', lowered) || mentionsRole('file_edit_position_start', lowered)) return null;
00197|   const commandOutput = parseCommandOutputRequest(request);
00198|   const fileRequest = commandOutput ? [commandOutput[0], ''] : parseWriteRequest(request);
00199|   if (!fileRequest) return composeRepositoryWorkPlan(request);
00200|   const target = fileRequest[0];
00201|   let content = literal === null ? withoutTrailingKnownModifier(fileRequest[1]) ?? fileRequest[1] : fileRequest[1];
00202|   const repaired = honouringPinnedFirstLine(instruction, content);
00203|   if (repaired !== null) {
00204|     traceRoute('general_change_plan', 'repaired_pinned_first_line');
00205|     content = repaired;
00206|   }
00207|   if (!safeRelativePath(target)) return null;
00208|   if (!commandOutput && describesCodeToAuthor(request, content)) return null;
00209|   if (!commandOutput && namesAnAddition(request, content, target)) return null;
00210|   const responseLanguage = detect(request);
00211|   const intent = formalizeIntent(request, responseLanguage);
00212|   const verificationCommand = `cat ${target}`;
00213|   const steps = [{
00214|     capability: Capability.Write,
00215|     action: (localizedResponse('general-plan-append-action', 'en') ?? '').replace('{plan_path}', PLAN_PATH),
00216|     expected_evidence: agenticMessage('general_planner_plan_event_evidence', { impulse_id: intent.impulse_id }),
00217|     command: null,
00218|   }];
00219|   if (commandOutput) {
00220|     steps.push({
00221|       capability: Capability.Run,
00222|       action: commandPlanText('general_plan_command_capture_action', responseLanguage, target),
00223|       expected_evidence: commandPlanText('general_plan_command_output_evidence', responseLanguage, target),
00224|       command: `${commandOutput[1]} > ${shellQuote(target)}`,
00225|     });
00226|   } else {
00227|     steps.push({
00228|       capability: Capability.Write,
00229|       action: agenticMessage('general_planner_write_content_action', { target }),
00230|       expected_evidence: agenticMessage('general_planner_workspace_file_evidence', { target }),
00231|       command: null,
00232|     });
00233|   }
00234|   steps.push({
00235|     capability: Capability.Run,
00236|     action: agenticMessage('general_planner_verification_action'),
00237|     expected_evidence: commandOutput
00238|       ? commandPlanText('general_plan_command_verification_evidence', responseLanguage, target)
00239|       : content,
00240|     command: verificationCommand,
00241|   });
00242|   return {
00243|     id: stableId('general_change_plan', `${intent.impulse_id}:${target}:${content}:${commandOutput ? commandOutput[1] : ''}`),
00244|     mode: commandOutput ? GeneralPlanMode.CommandOutput : GeneralPlanMode.LiteralFile,
00245|     goal: intent.source_text,
00246|     target,
00247|     content,
00248|     steps,
00249|     verification_command: verificationCommand,
00250|     terminal_state: PlanTerminalState.Executed,
00251|   };
00252| }

00254| function composeRepositoryWorkPlan(request) {
00255|   const target = repositoryWorkReference(request);
00256|   if (target === null) return null;
00257|   // Mirrors `opens_with_reference`: Hive Mind's objective field (`Issue to
00258|   // solve: <url>`, the prepared branch, "Proceed.") carries its verb in the
00259|   // delimiter `objectiveText` already stripped, so an objective that opens
00260|   // with the work-item reference is that field (issues #1154 and #1155).
00261|   const first = splitWhitespace(request)[0];
00262|   const opensWithReference = first !== undefined && repositoryWorkReference(first) !== null;
00263|   if (!opensWithReference && !mentionsBareRole(request, 'software_authoring_action')) return null;
00264|   const responseLanguage = detect(request);
00265|   const intent = formalizeIntent(request, responseLanguage);
00266|   return {
00267|     id: stableId('repository_work_item_plan', `${intent.impulse_id}:${target}`),
00268|     mode: GeneralPlanMode.RepositoryWorkItem,
00269|     goal: intent.source_text,
00270|     target,
00271|     content: '',
00272|     steps: [
00273|       workItemStep(Capability.Fetch, 'read', responseLanguage, target),
00274|       workItemStep(Capability.Write, 'action', responseLanguage, PLAN_PATH),
00275|     ],
00276|     verification_command: '',
00277|     terminal_state: PlanTerminalState.PlannedNotExecuted,

00281| function workItemStep(capability, slug, language, target) {
00282|   const evidence = slug === 'read' ? 'general_plan_repository_read_evidence' : 'general_plan_repository_evidence';
00283|   return {
00284|     capability,
00285|     action: commandPlanText(`general_plan_repository_${slug}`, language, target),
00286|     expected_evidence: commandPlanText(evidence, language, target),
00287|     command: null,
00288|   };

00291| const URL_EDGE = charIn('<>()[]{},;."\'。，、；：（）「」«»।');

00293| /** Mirrors `fn repository_work_reference`. @param {string} request @returns {string|null} */
00294| export function repositoryWorkReference(request) {
00295|   for (const token of splitWhitespace(request)) {
00296|     const url = trimMatches(token, URL_EDGE);
00297|     const path = url.startsWith('https://github.com/')
00298|       ? url.slice('https://github.com/'.length)
00299|       : url.startsWith('http://github.com/') ? url.slice('http://github.com/'.length) : null;
00300|     if (path === null) continue;
00301|     const segments = path.split('/');
00302|     if (segments.length === 4 && segments[0] && segments[1] && (segments[2] === 'issues' || segments[2] === 'pull')
00303|       && Array.from(segments[3]).every(isAsciiDigit)) return url;
00304|   }
00305|   return null;
00306| }

00308| function parseCommandOutputRequest(request) {
00309|   const toks = tokens(request);
00310|   const runVerbs = terminalCommandVocabulary().run_verbs;
00311|   const actions = bareSurfaces('file_write_action_cue');
00312|   const targets = bareSurfaces('file_write_target_cue');
00313|   const destinations = bareSurfaces('file_write_destination_cue');
00314|   for (const run of toks.filter((token) => runVerbs.includes(cleanCueToken(token.text)))) {
00315|     const tail = request.slice(run.end);
00316|     const leading = tail.length - trimStart(tail).length;
00317|     const quoted = tail.slice(leading);
00318|     const quote = Array.from(quoted)[0];
00319|     if (quote === undefined) return null;
00320|     if (quote !== "'" && quote !== '"' && quote !== '`') continue;
00321|     const body = quoted.slice(1);
00322|     const close = body.indexOf(quote);
00323|     if (close < 0) continue;
00324|     const command = trim(body.slice(0, close));
00325|     if (!command || /[\n\r\0]/.test(command)) continue;
00326|     const suffix = request.slice(run.end + leading + 1 + close + 1);
00327|     if (!mentionsBareRole(suffix, 'file_write_command_output_reference')) continue;
00328|     const suffixTokens = tokens(suffix);
00329|     if (!suffixTokens.some((token) => actions.includes(cleanCueToken(token.text)))) continue;
00330|     let target = null;
00331|     for (let index = 1; index < suffixTokens.length; index += 1) {
00332|       const cleaned = cleanPathToken(suffixTokens[index].text);
00333|       const cue = cleanCueToken(suffixTokens[index - 1].text);
00334|       if (looksLikeFilePath(cleaned) && safeRelativePath(cleaned) && (targets.includes(cue) || destinations.includes(cue))) {
00335|         target = cleaned;
00336|         break;
00337|       }
00338|     }
00339|     if (target !== null) return [target, command];
00340|   }
00341|   return null;
00342| }

00344| /** Mirrors `fn mentions_bare_role`. */
00345| export function mentionsBareRole(text, role) {
00346|   const lowerText = text.toLowerCase();
00347|   return roleWordForms(role).filter((form) => form.slot === 'bare').some((form) => {
00348|     const needle = form.text.toLowerCase();
00349|     const start = lowerText.indexOf(needle);
00350|     if (start < 0) return false;
00351|     if (!isAscii(needle)) return true;
00352|     const end = start + needle.length;
00353|     const beforeOk = start === 0 || !isAlphanumeric(lastChar(lowerText.slice(0, start)));
00354|     const afterOk = end === lowerText.length || !isAlphanumeric(Array.from(lowerText.slice(end, end + 2))[0]);
00355|     return beforeOk && afterOk;
00356|   });
00357| }

00368| /** Mirrors `fn has_file_write_intent`. @param {string} lower */

00373| /** Mirrors `fn has_authoritative_literal_write`. @param {string} request */
00374| export function hasAuthoritativeLiteralWrite(request) {
00375|   return (firstPrefixLeadEnd(request.toLowerCase(), 'file_write_authoritative_content_lead') !== null

00379| function parseWriteRequest(request) {
00380|   const toks = tokens(request);
00381|   const literal = literalPayload(request);
00382|   if (literal !== null) {
00383|     // A closed whole-file payload has already supplied the content. Only
00384|     // target cues before it bind the file; its internal prose is authored data.
00385|     const binding = rankedBindings(toks).find((candidate) =>
00386|       toks[candidate.index].end <= literal.start && candidate.cue_end <= literal.start
00387|       && bindingHasWriteInstruction(request, toks, candidate));
00388|     if (binding) return [binding.path, cleanContent(request.slice(literal.start, literal.end)) ?? literal.text];
00389|   }
00390|   for (const binding of rankedBindings(toks)) {
00391|     const parsed = parseWriteRequestBound(request, toks, binding);
00392|     if (parsed) return parsed;
00393|   }
00394|   return null;

00397| /** Mirrors `fn binding_has_write_instruction`: a write cue cannot authorize another statement. */
00398| function bindingHasWriteInstruction(request, toks, binding) {
00399|   const clauseStart = binding.cue_precedes ? binding.cue_start : toks[binding.index].start;
00400|   const scoped = statementScope(request);
00401|   const sentence = proseSentences(scoped).find((item) => {
00402|     const span = spanOf(item);
00403|     return clauseStart >= span.start && clauseStart < span.end;
00404|   });
00405|   if (sentence === undefined) return false;
00406|   const span = spanOf(sentence);
00407|   const target = toks[binding.index];
00408|   if (target.start < span.start || target.end > span.end
00409|     || binding.cue_start < span.start || binding.cue_end > span.end) return false;
00410|   const statement = slice(scoped, span.start, span.end);
00411|   if (statement === null) return false;
00412|   const localAction = firstActionCueStart(tokens(statement));
00413|   const actionStart = localAction === null ? null : span.start + localAction;
00414|   const before = slice(request, span.start, actionStart ?? toks[binding.index].start);
00415|   return before !== null && !mentionsRole('file_read_action_cue', normalizePrompt(before));
00416| }

00418| const slice = (text, start, end) => (start <= end && end <= text.length ? text.slice(start, end) : null);

00420| function parseWriteRequestBound(request, toks, binding) {
00421|   if (!bindingHasWriteInstruction(request, toks, binding)) return null;
00422|   const lowered = request.toLowerCase();
00423|   const destCues = bareSurfaces('file_write_destination_cue');
00424|   const fileIndex = binding.index;
00425|   const target = binding.path;
00426|   const clauseStart = binding.cue_precedes ? binding.cue_start : toks[fileIndex].start;
00427|   const cueIsDestination = binding.family === CueFamily.Destination;
00428|   const specification = composedDocumentSpecificationSpan(request);
00429|   const specificationSpan = specification ? spanOf({ span: specification }) : null;
00430|   const lead = firstRawContentLeadEnd(request);
00431|   if (lead) {
00432|     const markerEnd = lead[1];
00433|     const insideSpecification = specificationSpan && markerEnd >= specificationSpan.start && markerEnd < specificationSpan.end;
00434|     if (!insideSpecification && positionsShareStatement(request, markerEnd, clauseStart)) {
00435|       const markerLeads = markerEnd <= clauseStart;
00436|       const statementEnd = markerLeads
00437|         ? endOfStatement(request, markerEnd, clauseStart)
00438|         : endOfStatement(request, markerEnd, request.length);
00439|       const close = rawContentLeadClose(request, markerEnd);
00440|       const payloadEnd = close === null ? statementEnd : Math.min(close, statementEnd);
00441|       const markerSpan = slice(request, markerEnd, payloadEnd);
00442|       if (!markerLeads || firstActionCueEnd(toks) !== null) {
00443|         const content = markerSpan === null ? null : cleanContent(markerSpan);
00444|         if (content !== null && isLiteralContent(content, markerSpan, mentionsRole('file_write_content_qualifier', normalizePrompt(request.slice(lead[0], markerEnd))))
00445|           && (!namesDeferredWorkProduct(content)
00446|             || firstPrefixLeadEnd(lowered, 'file_write_authoritative_content_lead') !== null
00447|             || literalPayload(request) !== null)) {
00448|           return [target, content];
00449|         }
00450|       }
00451|     }
00452|   }
00453|   let contentSpan;
